title: Doubts about financing of the AI buildout
what_happened: A sell-off concentrated in AI and semiconductor shares, attributed in press reports to doubts about whether the debt-financed AI buildout can earn sufficient returns and to signs of moderating AI spending.
how_it_reaches_markets: Large index weight of AI-linked companies; debt used to fund data centers; possible regulatory opposition to data center construction.

sourced_facts.text: Federal Reserve Governor Barr, 2026-11-16: 'the AI buildout has been increasingly funded by debt'; on-balance-sheet debt of the seven largest AI firms 'is expected to exceed $800 billion before year's end'; he adds that he is 'less concerned about direct losses' given the still-limited debt behind the boom

Federal Reserve Financial Stability Report (November 2026, data to 2026-10-28): 'Bond issuance by the largest investment-grade firms involved in operating data centers was greater than $150 billion year to date'; 'Measures of equity valuations have remained elevated since the previous report'

resolved_when_all: Nasdaq Composite closes above its close of the day before the losing streak began for 20 consecutive trading days
Equity volatility component of this ledger is Moderate or lower for 20 consecutive trading days
At least two of the largest AI infrastructure spenders reaffirm or raise capital spending plans in a quarterly report
worsened_when_any: A large AI-linked borrower misses a debt payment or cancels a publicly announced financing
A major AI infrastructure spender publicly cuts its capital spending plan

relief_headlines_that_do_not_resolve_it: One company beating earnings forecasts (Dell beat forecasts on 2026-11-24 and its shares still fell about 7% the next day)

history.note: Card opened. Resolution conditions written before the outcome is known.

Sources upgraded. The debt-financing concern is now supported by a Federal Reserve governor's speech and the Financial Stability Report. The index and share-price moves of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-25 are not yet confirmed at an accepted source and were moved to unconfirmed_facts.

note: Risk state only. Not a forecast and not investment advice.

The exact level will be written here once the series has been read; until then this condition cannot be marked as met.
'Largest AI infrastructure spenders' means Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle. 'Large AI-linked borrower' means one with at least $1 billion of debt outstanding.
